name: mvane yard
author: Alexandre Enkerli
tagline: chords from any scale, Clipper's sounds, MPE, and a recorder that keeps everything
description: A performance firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1. Play notes, or chords from any of eight pitch-class sets (Coral Flower-style qualities or the scale's own types, close, open, wide or paired voicings, a separate bass, smooth voice leading, HOLD), through Clipper's 337 factory sounds or a simple saw, with MPE in and out, breath and mono legato. A recorder that never stops keeps what you played: capture it after the fact, replay it through other sounds, save eight takes, take them to a DAW as MIDI.
credits: Built on fm1-base (MPL-2.0) and felucca-bsp; the sounds are Clipper's synth (GPL-3.0, by 3dSam and contributors, after SLOOP and Felucca by Leo Kuroshita).
